Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing & Communications Operations Lead position at Pulse Foundation. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in SEO, GEO, and web design, I am excited about the opportunity to combine storytelling with efficiency, especially through AI-driven automation.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build/maintain WordPress sites. I have hands-on experience with analytics tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush, and I am comfortable with social media coordination. On my own project, mirook.com, I have implemented structured data and AI-focused optimizations, demonstrating my ability to leverage technology for visibility.

I am particularly drawn to your mission of using AI to automate recurring tasks. I have experience with AI-assisted content tools and am eager to design and deploy AI agents using platforms like Zapier/Make. My background in front-end development and my current focus on digital marketing make me well-suited to manage your websites, CRM, and communication workflows.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and work in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1. I would love to contribute to your team and help scale your impact.

Best regards,

Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing & Communications Operations Lead role at Pulse Foundation. Your mission to combine storytelling with efficiency resonates deeply with me, as I have built my career on the intersection of creative content and technical optimization.

In my current position as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO for client websites, write keyword-targeted blog content, and build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. I track performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console, using data to guide content and SEO decisions. This experience has given me a solid foundation in content creation, CMS management, and performance monitoring—skills directly relevant to managing your editorial calendar, websites, and KPIs.

What sets me apart is my technical background and my proactive approach to AI and automation. On my own project, mirook.com, I have implemented structured data (JSON-LD), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. I have also used AI-assisted content tools to streamline workflows. I am eager to apply this mindset to identify low-value manual tasks and design AI agents using platforms like Zapier or Make, freeing up time for strategic work.

I am also comfortable with social media coordination and have experience with CRM concepts, as I have managed content integration for social platforms. My front-end development background (AngularJS, JavaScript) gives me an edge in overseeing website maintenance and collaborating with technical teams.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and work in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 and improving. I am passionate about mentoring and would enjoy guiding interns, as I have done informally in my current role.

I would love to bring my blend of marketing, technical, and AI skills to Pulse Foundation. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
